text: Bounded read-only research for the user's later Quick App/service validation phase. Root owns live factory rebuild and all hardware. Existing report backups/factory-demo-port/quickapp-next-review/readiness-report.md found local libs_openvela_vela assets only x86_64/ARM and no proven compatible RV32 ilp32f Quick App core. Check official open-vela public repositories/manifests/documentation for an actually published matching RISC-V 32-bit libquickapp/gui_wrapper/quickappfeatures/inspector runtime package. Do not assume the one catalogue is exhaustive. Distinguish RV32 from RV64 and Xtensa, and incompatible ABI/library versions. Use only primary official sources, list precise repository/ref/path evidence; if no matching package is found, state the searched scope rather than claiming global nonexistence. No builds, no maintained edits, no serial/USB/hardware, no external messages, no network security testing. No huge downloads; inspect small metadata or archive architecture only when a plausible RV32 package is identified. Read locally only the cited readiness report and narrow Quick App CMake/include/version fields. Write only this directory readiness-report.md. Do not ask user questions. Finish bounded research promptly (roughly 5 minutes); Root will execute subsequent tests in the agreed order.

I’ll check official open-vela repositories, manifests, and documentation for a published RV32 runtime package, compare any candidates against the local ABI and version requirements, and record the bounded findings in the readiness report.

No matching RV32/`ilp32f` runtime package was identified in this documentation/release scope.

| Official repository/ref/path | Finding |
|---|---|
| [`frameworks_runtimes_quickapp`, `dev`, `README_en.md`](https://github.com/open-vela/frameworks_runtimes_quickapp/blob/dev/README_en.md#prebuilt-artifacts) | Lists `quickapp`, `gui_wrapper`, `quickappfeatures`, and `quickapp_inspector` as prebuilt static libraries; Constraints says core source is excluded. No RV32 architecture/ABI package matrix or download pointer was found. |
| [`frameworks_runtimes_quickapp`, `dev`, `CMakeLists.txt`](https://github.com/open-vela/frameworks_runtimes_quickapp/blob/dev/CMakeLists.txt#L34) | `nuttx_add_prebuilt` declares those four targets plus `vapp`/`vappxms`; this is an integration declaration, without an RV32 artifact specification. |
| [`frameworks_runtimes_quickapp` releases](https://github.com/open-vela/frameworks_runtimes_quickapp/releases) | Public page explicitly reports no releases. |
| [`docs`, release `trunk-5.5`](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/releases/tag/trunk-5.5) | QuickApp section names QuickJS, runtime_feature and runtime_ash source publication. It does not identify an RV32 container-core bundle. Breaking changes include QuickApp interfaces, `UVTaskQueue` replacement, and LVGL animation interface adaptation—release names alone cannot establish compatibility with the recorded baseline. |
| [`frameworks_runtimes_feature`, `dev`, `README.md`](https://github.com/open-vela/frameworks_runtimes_feature/blob/dev/README.md) | Describes native/JavaScript bindings, API tooling and JIDL. This is not evidence that the distinct four-library container package was published for RV32. |
| [`docs`, `dev`, `en/api/framework/quickapp/index.md`](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev/en/api/framework/quickapp/index.md) | General QuickApp description and API reference link, without architecture-specific runtime distribution. |

Bounded indexed searches combined official repository restrictions with `libquickapp`, `libgui_wrapper.a`, `quickapp_inspector`, `riscv`, `riscv32`, `riscv64`, `RISC-V`, and `ilp32f`. No positive package pointer resulted. RISC-V architecture support in general release notes does not distinguish RV32/RV64 or prove `ilp32f`; ESP32-S3 examples likewise do not establish ESP32S31 compatibility.

Limitations: GitHub API metadata endpoints were unavailable through the browser tool, so this does **not** independently establish the complete release asset inventory or all repository history. No archive downloads, local reads, or writes were performed.
